slides.text: When the Cult of the Crimson Void accidentally butchered the pronunciation of an ancient Aramaic invocation, they didn't summon Beelzebub, Lord of Flies. They summoned Marcus, a senior management consultant from Deloitte who had been midway through polishing a pitch deck. Before the hooded cultists could brandish their sacrificial daggers, Marcus adjusted his wire-rimmed spectacles, sighed at the damp cavern walls, and asked who had authorized this meeting without an agenda.

Within forty-eight hours, Marcus had implemented two-week agile sprints across the Seventh Circle of Hell. Torment quotas were replaced with measurable Key Performance Indicators, and the lake of boiling sulfur was temporarily decommissioned for an OSHA compliance audit. The damned souls were issued laminated feedback surveys, while the horned pit fiends were forced to attend mandatory morning standup meetings where everyone had to share one personal win and one logistical blocker.

By week three, the Prince of Darkness was slumped over an ergonomic desk in sheer exhaustion, begging Marcus for a ceasefire. 'The screams of agony have completely stopped,' Lucifer groaned, massaging his temples. 'Now my demons just complain about calendar density and cross-functional alignment.' Marcus tapped the whiteboard with dry-erase marker. 'Well, your quarterly deliverables are up twelve percent,' he replied cheerfully. 'Now let’s talk about streamlining our eternal damnation onboarding workflow.'
